data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, communication surfaces, and explicitly identified public organizational actors can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 413, 419, and 425 for the anarchist-violence area-code-hunt workflow?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current U.S. geographic NANP membership, literal and locality-derived public-web searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, historical-directory seed checks, and explicit public-role person cross-enumeration.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Organization-level political or ideological descriptors are not projected onto individual people.
Person-to-organization relations in this pass record only explicit public roles or representations; no political affiliation is inferred.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Weak or uncorroborated status signals remain historical/status-uncertain rather than being silently promoted.

findings.notes: Amherst Community Connections and HRH413 retained as current Western Massachusetts mutual-aid/direct-service organizations. First-party pages explicitly identify Hwei-Ling Greeney as ACC founder/executive director and Jess Tilley plus Albie Park as HRH413 co-founders.

Equality Toledo is retained as a current Toledo-area nonprofit with a no-barriers community pantry; first-party pages explicitly identify Brent Rabie, Rachel Richardson, Kwinlyn Tyler, and Delaney Carnes in current leadership/program roles. Mutual Aid Toledo remains historical/status-uncertain because a public mutual-aid directory and 2020 reporting were found but current first-party activity was not independently confirmed.

Eastside Food Not Bombs and Snohomish County Mutual Aid retained as current/recent. Eastside Food Not Bombs publishes current Bellevue/Redmond distributions and horizontal mutual-aid principles. Snohomish County Mutual Aid has current fiscal-sponsor/public-donation evidence and exact public handle @snocomutualaid. No sufficiently explicit public leadership identity was promoted for either organization in this bounded pass.
